name: Summer of STEM Adventures
description_short: Week-long, hands-on STEM programs for rising K-8 students on Talcott Mountain in Avon, CT. Each week offers different classes (robotics, coding, marine science, paleontology and more) grouped into K-2, 3-5 and 6-8 grade bands, and some include field trips.

sources.note: 2026 season; each one-week class costs $515 to $605 early bird, $575 to $675 regular, plus a $6.50 registration fee
Hours 9:00 to 4:00, no before or after care; bring lunch and snack
Bus is provided and required, from stops in West Hartford and Avon

source.title: Summer of STEM Adventures - Talcott Mountain Science Center, Academy, & Research Institute

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.

Prices depend on the class and grade band, not the week. In 2026, K-2 classes were usually $515 early bird / $575 regular, grades 3-8 classes $560/$625, and classes with field trips or kits $605/$675. Because of this, I left session prices empty.
There is also a $6.50 registration fee per course, on top of tuition.
The site lists two phone numbers: 860-677-8571 for summer programs and 860-677-0035 for the main office.
Camp Invention (Week 7) uses different grade bands (grades 1-3 and 4-6) and costs $540 early bird / $600 regular.

changes: Added price_per_week $625, the regular price of most one-week classes in 2026 (range stays $515 to $675).
Added extended_care false and meals_included false: hours are 9 to 4 with no before or after care, and children bring lunch.
Added refund policy and special needs notes from the policies page.
Moved the transportation source to the transportation page, which says the bus from West Hartford or Avon is provided and required.
Note for the listing: the center calls this a classroom-based summer program, not a day camp; camp_type stays day.

refund_policy_summary: More than two weeks before the start: full credit or a 90% refund. Between two weeks and two business days before: 50% refund or credit. Less than two business days before: no refund. No refunds for days missed through illness.
special_needs_notes: Children with special needs are welcome if they can follow the behavior policy, are toilet trained and can follow spoken instructions. Families may bring their own paraprofessional; the center cannot provide aides. A nut-free table is set up at snack and lunch.
